Container.Name: SceneNFO
Container.Overview: SceneNFO scans Radarr and Sonarr media libraries, classifies releases as Scene or P2P using exact PreDB.club matches, manages Scene NFO files from srrDB, PreDB.club and crowdNFO, and provides live scans, history, logs, schedules and import automation.
Container.Requires: Internet access is required for PreDB.club, srrDB and crowdNFO. The GHCR package must be public so Unraid can pull the image without registry credentials.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent SceneNFO configuration, SQLite database, encrypted credentials, logs and temporary files.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Radarr and Sonarr media root. SceneNFO needs write access when Apply mode is used to create or replace NFO files. You can set this to read-only for initial Dry Run testing.

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Internal SceneNFO configuration directory. Normally leave this unchanged.
